messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Can not perfom HELP!!!
parts:
On 05/06/2013 10:36 PM, Pablo Menese Camargo wrote:
> I made CFA in STATA, AMOS and sem package, all gave me the same.
> When I tried to do with lavaan I can not have the same results...
> any idea?

Well, you do not say what is different.

> fit2<-cfa(modelo2, data=i_p_efa_cfa_irt)

But in the 'sem' syntax, the latent variables are standardized, so you
may try:

fit2<-cfa(modelo2, data=i_p_efa_cfa_irt, std.lv=TRUE)

Yves.
